notes.title: Graphics Settings Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35413159/b997da5aba92e78b14c02fea1029824a12b55988.png[/img]

Hello, Bartenders!

We have a quick little update for all of you. Alongside some bug fixes and quality of life changes, we have added a drop-down in the options menu where you can change the game's graphics quality. If the game didn't run too well for you, you should now be able to lower the graphics quality and smoothly mix those drinks.

The other minor changes include:
[list]
[*] Having an order to ingredients in the "drink results" screen, so you have an easier time at seeing what you got right/wrong.
[*] Fixing issues where a manager note would not properly be applied to the drink.
[*] Specifying what the "drink year" is in the tutorial.
[/list]

Please let us know if you have any issues with the game. We constantly check the discussions board here on our steam page, and we also have a Discord server where you can usually get a reply from someone on the team within a few minutes. You can join our Discord server here: https://discord.gg/gp9Kmyr

Once again, thank you to everyone that has taken interest in our little game!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35413159/f68d0c989f55af921fa361f8ed5c5732b2219574.png[/img]

notes.title: Release + Discord!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35413159/27133fb54bf230a4d732e3204a42ab2affdf167e.png[/img]

The game is out! We are so excited for people to start playing Uh Oh Bartender. The game is so much fun to watch people play, especially for us. 

We would love to foster a community with all of you. So please feel free to post images and gifs here on Steam's discussion board, or you can join our discord here: https://discord.gg/gp9Kmyr

We plan to be very active in the community, especially on the discord where we will be showing images, gifs, and videos of new games we work on and other dumb stuff we end up doing.

Thank you so much to everyone who has taken an interest in our little game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35413159/f68d0c989f55af921fa361f8ed5c5732b2219574.png[/img]

notes.title: Welcome To Uh Oh Bartender and to Whoah! Games!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35413159/1b4f49ab2f5d488633f4aeb33919b785b771a696.png[/img]

Hello and thank you for taking interest in our first game! This means a lot to us, so we would love to hear any feedback and see any wacky screenshots that guys may have. 

When we first conceptualized this game, we knew we wanted something simple and replayable. We ended up producing a game inspired by Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes, but with a bartending twist. As the game progressed in development we started noticing how unexpectedly hilarious we found certain parts of the game to be. From the dumb, randomly generated drink names to the absurdly underage costumers, this game has been incredibly fun to create and playtest. We hope you guys have just as much fun playing it as we had making it.

We are basically a company filled with game dev amateurs, but we are very ambitious and motivated amateurs. Being a group of childhood friends, we have a blast when together, and we are used to yelling at each other when needed. To put it simply, we love each other and we love making games.

That being said, we are also a bunch of buffoons who came up with the crazy idea of creating a new game every month this summer. This is the first game that has been created by way of this challenge and it turned out so much better than we ever could have hoped for. 

Just because we have this foolish one-game-a-month challenge, doesn't mean we will never update this game or touch this game again. Although it'll make the next 2 months much harder, we plan to be very active in the community and put out updates including bug fixes and gameplay balances as needed. Any new content updates, if we ever do make any (we have already talked about a few ideas for some), probably won't come out until after the summer is over.

Once again, thank you so much to all of you. Even if all you did was look at our steam page and not buy the game, that still shows that there was something about our game that interested you. This is a whole new experience for us and we're all feeling an intense rush of emotions moving into the release of our first game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35413159/f68d0c989f55af921fa361f8ed5c5732b2219574.png[/img]
